comment: M59: the upgrade reference worlds of this branch are built, not stored. smoketestUpgrade (and runServer -PsmoketestOldWorld) build a missing one in the saves folder of the run with tools/upgrade/<script> from the commit named here (build_reference.sh: that commit's buildShowcase plus DevUpgradeReference). 'default' is the world smoketestUpgrade loads without -PupgradeWorld; the reference of this branch was made with its first version 1.42.0-beta.1. 'crossVersion': worlds of an older Minecraft version that smoketestUpgrade (and the Fabric fabricUpgradeTest) load after the default, built by a commit of that version's branch with its own tools ("tools": "own"). M68: build_reference.sh takes the old-side class 'class' of tools/upgrade (default DevUpgradeReference); 'suite' are the worlds smoketestUpgrade loads one after another without -PupgradeWorld (this branch's reference, the 1.21.1 world and the M67 world with the old pipe system).
